text: Helly Hansen is a brand of Kontoor Brands, Inc. (NYSE: KTB), the listed US apparel company (Wrangler, Lee); Kontoor completed the acquisition of Helly Hansen on 2 June 2025.
short: Helly Hansen is owned by Kontoor Brands, Inc. (NYSE: KTB) since June 2025.

source.name: Kontoor Brands: 'Kontoor Brands Completes Acquisition of Helly Hansen'
source.quote: Kontoor Brands, Inc. (NYSE: KTB) today announced that it has completed the previously announced acquisition of Helly Hansen, the global outdoor and workwear brand.
